pages.title: Nether Star
pages.text: Dropped by the **Wither**. A power source that never runs dry.

pages.title: How
pages.text: Collect three Wither Skeleton Skulls from Nether Fortresses and summon the Wither somewhere you don't mind wrecking. [#](2E5AAC)[Big Cannons](entry://industry/cannons)[#]() and autocannons work well from a bunker. Summon it again for more stars.
